title: Awesome experience
text: I booked this event for my daughters birthday dinner and this was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona.  Victor and Kiira were amazing hosts  and the food was incredible.  I have already started spreading the word to everyone that I know who is planning a trip to Barcelona.  This event is highly recommended!
author: Sontia_G

title: Ein unvergesslicher Abend bei Victor & Kiira.
text:
What an unforgettable evening! Victor and Kiira are fantastic hosts who made us feel welcome from the very beginning with their warm and friendly nature. The barbecue was absolutely delicious, and the whole atmosphere was simply wonderful.

We especially appreciated all the personal tips and recommendations they shared with us, which made our first stay in Barcelona even more special. We felt completely at home and would highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Barcelona. Thank you, Victor and Kiira, for such a wonderful evening!
author: DrCortex3

title: Fantastic BBQ evening in BCN 🇪🇸
text:
A thoroughly successful BBQ evening on a beautiful rooftop terrace in Barcelona! The atmosphere was simply fantastic – with a great view over the city, delicious food, and a relaxed, sociable vibe. The grilled food was fresh and excellently prepared, and the side dishes and drinks left nothing to be desired. The host Viktor and his wife were very warm and ensured that everyone felt welcome. An unforgettable experience that I can recommend to anyone wanting to spend a special evening in Barcelona. Happy to return – 5 stars!
Best regards, Philipp 🇩🇪
